item.title: The Netherlands moves 86 tonnes of gold out of US due to 'geopolitical unrest' as experts warn it is 'no longer safe' under Trump
item.description: The Netherlands has moved 86 tonnes of its gold stock out of the US and Canada to London due to 'increasing geopolitical unrest'. The move follows alarming remarks that gold is 'no longer safe' in President Donald Trump's America. Moving these stores to British soil would 'spread risks' and would ensure the 'quickest' opportunity for DNB to deploy the sale of gold 'in a crisis situation,' the bank wrote in a statement. Trump's unpredictability has been previously cited as a key reason as to why the Netherlands should remove their gold from the US. The director of Goudwisselkantoor – a Dutch auction house that specialises in auctioning gold, jewellery, diamonds, silverware, coins and banknotes – said in January that Trump could 'refuse to extradite [the gold reserves], impose additional tariffs, or delay the repayment for decades'. https://www.dailymail.com/news/article-16099075/Netherlands-moves-gold-US-geopolitical-unrest.html

item.title: Can’t Have a Pentagon Full of Dissent if You Keep Getting Rid of the Fucking Dissenters
item.description:
Apparently the revolutionary new strategy for strengthening military leadership is to keep taking a fucking weed-whacker to the leadership. Hegseth's latest shake-up reportedly targets seven more Army officers who had been selected for promotion to two-star general, while the broader cuts have already hit roughly 10% of the military's top officers. And now Army Secretary Dan Driscoll is out amid the turmoil. There are legitimate reasons to replace senior officers. There are legitimate reasons to reform the Pentagon. But when the departures keep piling up and professional disagreement starts looking suspiciously like a fucking career-ending condition, eventually you've got to ask what you're building: A military leadership team capable of telling civilian leaders uncomfortable truths? Or the world's most heavily armed fucking group chat where everyone knows the only acceptable reply is “YES, SIR.” Can't have disagreements with senior officers if you keep getting rid of the fucking officers.
